product_metadata.title: RABAHA 13" Acacia Cake Stand Rotating – Rustic Cake Stand Set Turntable with 2 Icing Spatulas, 3 Smoothers – Wooden Revolving Spinner Cake Decorating Supplies - Use at Parties, Wedding (Acacia Wood)
features: ✅Natural, Enviromantally-Friendly -- Made of 100% Acacia wood, which is the most durable and top-quality wood used for manufacturing. It is a completely green and safe way to place and decorate cakes. Colors suitable for rustic or modern style.

✅A Smooth 360° Rotation Bearing: The square ball bearing plates are available in 3.7” and 300Lbs capacities. With a smooth rotation mode, users can easily reach other cake sides. A non-slip mat is also added to keep the turntable cake stand excellent stability in place while decorating and displaying.

✅Multi Use -- Perfect for weddings, bakeries, birthday and dinner parties, anniversaries, or any special occasion, these revolving serving platters are perfect for displaying your baked goods and desserts. With the convenience of a spinner, your guests can easily access the delicious treats you've prepared.

✅Cake Decorating Supplies - 1 Acacia Wood Cake Stand, 2 Icing Spatulas, and 3 Comb Icing Smoothers are the perfect addition to your baking supplies, allowing you to invent all types of patterns on cakes or cupcakes.

✅Easy To Clean -- Apart from being made of Acacia wood, which is waterproof, the stand is coated in a thin layer of paint, so you can easily clean it by rinsing it with warm soapy water and air drying.
✅Ideal For Large Cakes -- This decorating stand measures 13” in diameter and 2.4” in height. It is stable and sturdy enough for both small and large cakes.
